page: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Eadv6 server family. Powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz and is equipped with 32 MB of L3 cache. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Additionally, the server is provisioned with 472 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core performance, with the stress-ng single-core CPU test and Geekbench single-core score both placing in the top 25% of tested hardware. Text processing capabilities are also strong. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing fall within the average range. Memory performance is mixed; while small-block cached read bandwidth and large-block write bandwidth are average, large-block uncached read bandwidth is weak, registering at 37.68 GB/sec. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput demonstrate average performance profiles. Large language model inference speeds are average for small models, but prompt processing for medium 7B models is weak.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E8ads_v6 offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads without requiring the purchase of excess compute resources. The inclusion of 472 GB of local storage provides a built-in storage buffer, though the lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses may require additional networking configuration. This server is well-suited for relational database management systems, in-memory caching layers such as Redis, data processing tasks, and general-purpose enterprise applications that demand a substantial memory footprint relative to CPU capacity.
description: Microsoft Azure E8ads_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Eadv6 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores, 64.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per core), and 472 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. Benchmarks show strong single-core CPU and text processing performance, while multi-core execution, software compilation, and database operations perform in the average tier. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth is a notable bottleneck, scoring in the bottom 25%. With a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads. It is highly suitable for database hosting, in-memory caching, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
